outcome: Concentration of circulating extracellular vesicles of placental origin (EV-P)
Differential abundance of proteins in EV-P
cohort: The study participants were women with early-onset preeclampsia and healthy pregnant women.
finding: The study found a significantly increased concentration of EOPE-derived EV-P and identified 26 differentially abundant proteins linked to innate immune responses, hemostasis, and oxygen homeostasis in EV-P from women with EOPE.
